subtitle: AI Dev Tools Zoomcamp 2026 Course Launch

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The new cohort starts with the same question many developers have: how do we use AI tools without losing control of the code we ship?

sections.heading: Workflow controls
bullets: The course is about developer workflow, not collecting tools
The path goes from planning and coding to agent capabilities, security, audit, and DevOps
The final project is where the workflow becomes concrete

sections.heading: Reason
sections.body: Make AI-assisted work easier to review, test, debug, and ship.
